Job Description:
 Focus: Data-driven transparency for all locations. 
 Location: Romania (Remote/Hybrid) Focus: Data Analytics and Compliance 
 Your Responsibilities:
Dashboarding: Development and maintenance of performance dashboards in ServiceNow and Skywise. 
Quality Assurance: Conducting ticket audits to monitor data quality and process compliance. 
Data Analysis: Creation of ad-hoc analyses to identify cost drivers and inefficiencies. 
Process Support: Providing assistance to German locations in measuring cost reduction measures. 
 Your Profile:
 Strong analytical skills and experience in handling large data volumes. 
 Proficient in ServiceNow Reporting and Skywise. 
 Detail-oriented working style and understanding of IT service structures. 
 What we offer:
 We offer you more than just a job: a career where you are truly valued. Alongside a competitive salary and innovative projects, you'll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, designed for you. 
 Attractive financial package: A competitive salary and multiple bonuses (for performance, attendance, and holidays). 
 Health and relaxation: A private medical plan with Regina Maria and access to wellness at Belaqva. 
 Flexibility and comfort: A hybrid work policy and provided transportation in the Brașov area. 
 This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth.
